name: KJ Game
desc:
-PLEASE READ: This game is in BETA and can be very UNSTABLE or GLITCHY. If you see any bugs, make a ticket in our communications server and we'll fix it as fast as we can.


🖥️ Controls
G - ultimate mode
F - block
Q - dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Left Click - punch
B - emote wheel
